title: 32 km inversion, 40 iterations of TAO lmvm (mass-consistent metric), for the optimizer comparison

results: /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_runs/optimizer_issue157/32km/tao/map.h5 (sha256 e6c3316b), log.txt, timing.json; the wrapper is 32km/run32.sh
